fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 1401 W Normantown Rd, Romeoville IL - CJ Logistics America (former DSC Logistics) DC. Single large warehouse off I-55 / Weber Rd, between Normantown Rd (north) and a retention pond (south).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property truck court is enclosed by a continuous black ornamental (wrought-iron-style) perimeter fence visible in 2018-2025 Street View. The truck driveway breaks through the fence with a gate opening - classified as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure visible at the truck-court driveway opening in any Street View probe; entry appears uncontrolled-by-personnel - hence remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock doors along the north face facing Normantown Rd, with trailers backed in continuously; estimated ~90 doors - low-confidence overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop yard with marked stalls on the east side of the building; additional trailers in the truck court.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Likely two driveway openings off Normantown Rd (one near the NW office, one for the truck court / east) - count is approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Romeoville is a dense Chicago-area logistics corridor (Will County warehouse cluster) - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property visible.
